ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly bimodal distribution with approximately 65% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and left-medial regions, and 35% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized on the right lobe and left distal periphery.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-intensity mass originating at the peduncle and extending into a broad diagonal wedge across the left lobe; right lobe characterized by a light-intensity field with a distinct dark apical tip and dark basal mottling near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation at the central axis dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primary boundary is relatively smooth along the medial sections, transitioning to irregular, low-amplitude serrations and small jagged peaks on the distal third of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature across the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips with an upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast dark circular spot (focal cluster) located in the medial-distal region of the right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of short, parallel dark-intensity lines (rake marks) on the distal tip of the right lobe; distinct unaligned linear streaks visible within the light field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single focal dark lesion or pigmentation spot on the mid-right lobe; jagged irregularities on the trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting minor past trauma.
